name: Emoji Reaction Slider
description: Rating card with a draggable slider thumb that snaps to five steps while an emoji face morphs its mouth, eyes and colors from awful to great.
contents: Card with title and current rating label
Morphing emoji face with five moods
Dotted slider track with colored fill and draggable thumb
behavior: Dragging the thumb updates the rating live and the face morphs through SVG path transitions
Thumb snaps to the nearest of five stops on release with an overshoot ease
Emoji bounces when the rating changes
Colors of the face, fill and label transition between ratings
Calls onChange with the label of the selected rating
editableByProps: Title and the five rating labels
Card, border, shadow, track and text colors

needsCodeEdit.change: Change number of steps or track length

needsCodeEdit.where: mouth and eye paths in RATINGS

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Always five rating steps and a fixed 264px track width
